# Educational Links of Interest

## 🤖 Artificial Intelligence for Education

**MagicSchool AI**
[https://www.magicschool.ai/](https://www.magicschool.ai/)
Artificial intelligence platform for teachers; helps create automated educational resources and experiences, reducing teaching workload.

---

**Google NotebookLM**
[https://notebooklm.google.com/](https://notebooklm.google/)
Google Labs AI for note-taking, research, and organizing information with documents, visual summaries, and collaboration.

---

**Lumivara**
[https://lumivara.at/](https://lumivara.at/)
Educational platform with AI that helps generate interactive materials, questionnaires and summaries.

---

**Kimi-ppt (Kimi Slides)**
[https://ppt.ai/es/kimi-ppt](https://ppt.ai/es/kimi-ppt)
AI that creates automatic presentations from text makes it easy to quickly generate slides for teachers and students.

---

## 🔬 Natural Sciences - Simulators and Virtual Laboratories

**PhET Interactive Simulations**
[https://phet.colorado.edu/](https://phet.colorado.edu/)
Free and interactive simulators for physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics experiments developed by the University of Colorado Boulder.

---

**ChemCollective**
[https://chemcollective.org/](https://chemcollective.org/)
Virtual laboratories and guided activities to teach chemistry, with simulations and interactive exercises.

---

**Algodoo**
[https://www.algodoo.com/](https://www.algodoo.com/)
2D physics sandbox to experiment and simulate physical phenomena through visual and creative simulation, free.

---

**Lab Simulations OER – Mines LibGuides**
[https://libguides.mines.edu/oer/simulationslabs](https://libguides.mines.edu/oer/simulationslabs)
Guide to open virtual laboratories and simulations, useful for STEM teaching.

---

**Ask A Biologist (ASU)**
[https://askabiologist.asu.edu/](https://askabiologist.asu.edu/)
Portal where students and teachers can ask biology questions from experts, with activities and multimedia resources.

---

**Biomolecules.cat**
[http://biomolecules.cat/](http://biomolecules.cat/)
Scientific and informative resources on biomolecules and molecular biology for teaching and dissemination.

---

**Climate Change Simulator**  
[https://www.climateinteractive.org/world-climate-simulation-spanish/](https://www.climateinteractive.org/world-climate-simulation-spanish/)  
World Climate Simulation is an in-person role-playing game about UN climate change negotiations. Through the simulation, participants explore the speed and work required by nations to address global climate change.

## 🌍 Geology and Earth Sciences

**Visible Geology**
[https://www.visiblegeology.com/](https://www.visiblegeology.com/)
Tool to create geological 3D diagrams and model visual and interactive structures.

---

**Tectonic Explorer – Concord Consortium**
[https://tectonic-explorer.concord.org/](https://tectonic-explorer.concord.org/)
Free simulator of tectonic processes to experiment with plates and rocks at an educational level.

---

**Paleolatitude.org**
[https://paleolatitude.org/#!/](https://paleolatitude.org/#!/)
Interactive calculator to visualize the paleogeographic latitude of any point on Earth.

---

**AEPECT**
[https://www.aepect.org/](https://www.aepect.org/)
Spanish Association for the Teaching of Earth Sciences, training and resources in geology.

---

**CNIG Digital Photo Library**
[https://fototeca.cnig.es/fototeca/](https://fototeca.cnig.es/fototeca/)
Digital repository to consult historical aerial photos of Spain, useful in geography and environmental studies.

---

## 🗺️ Mind Maps and Visual Organizers

**XMind**
[https://xmind.com/es/](https://xmind.com/es/)
Collaborative mind mapping and AI-assisted brainstorming tool, useful for organizing concepts and projects.

---

**IHMC CmapTools**
[https://cmap.ihmc.us/products/](https://cmap.ihmc.us/products/)
Software for concept maps, allows you to create, share and edit knowledge and learning models.

---

**CmapTools – IHMC**
[https://cmap.ihmc.us/](https://cmap.ihmc.us/)
Visual tool to create and share concept maps in science and education.

---

**MindMup**
[https://www.mindmup.com/](https://www.mindmup.com/)
Online tool to create mind maps quickly and easily.

---

**Instamaps**
[https://www.instamaps.cat/#/](https://www.instamaps.cat/#/)
Free platform to create collaborative maps and interactive geographic visualizations.

---

## 📊 Interactive Tools for the Classroom

**Wooclap Word Cloud Generator**
[https://www.wooclap.com/en/word-cloud-generator/](https://www.wooclap.com/en/word-cloud-generator/)
Instant word cloud creation tool, useful for visual summary and group analysis in class.

---

**Mentimeter: Event evaluation**
[https://www.mentimeter.com/templates/p/speakers-evaluate-event](https://www.mentimeter.com/templates/p/speakers-evaluate-event)
Templates to rate speakers and events with dynamic and interactive presentations.

---

## 💻 Educational Programming and Technology

**Scratch**
[https://scratch.mit.edu/](https://scratch.mit.edu/)
Free visual programming platform where students and teachers create interactive games and animations.

---

**Binario**  
[https://www.puzzle-binairo.com/binairo-6x6-easy/](https://www.puzzle-binairo.com/binairo-6x6-easy/)  
Logic puzzle game to solve.

## 🎓 Inquiry and STEM Methodologies

**LabInquiry – IQS Investigation**
[https://iqs.edu/es/investigacion/proyectos-investigacion/labinquiry-labs-for-inquiry-based-teaching-in-mathematics-and-beyond/](https://iqs.edu/es/investigacion/proyectos-investigacion/labinquiry-labs-for-inquiry-based-teaching-in-mathematics-and-beyond/)
International project on inquiry and laboratory in mathematics and science using STEM methodology.

---

**LabInquiry – UB Secondary**
[https://www.ub.edu/labinquiry/categoria/secundaria/](https://www.ub.edu/labinquiry/categoria/secundaria/)
Activities and didactic inquiry proposals for secondary school, in collaboration with the UB.

---

## 🎨 Concept Cartoons and Teaching Resources

**Science Concept Cartoons – STEM Learning**
[https://www.stem.org.uk/resources/library/collection/4226/science-concept-cartoons](https://www.stem.org.uk/resources/library/collection/4226/science-concept-cartoons)
Educational comics that promote scientific discussion and identify misconceptions.

---

**Concept Cartoons – Science Education Research**
[https://science-education-research.com/teaching-science/concept-cartoons/](https://science-education-research.com/teaching-science/concept-cartoons/)
Resources and explanation on using vignettes to detect and address misconceptions in science.

---

**Nature of Science Concept Cartoons – RSC Education**
[https://edu.rsc.org/resources/the-nature-of-science-concept-cartoons/1277.article](https://edu.rsc.org/resources/the-nature-of-science-concept-cartoons/1277.article)
Cartoons that help debate and diagnose key ideas in natural sciences.

---

**Science Concept Cartoons – Classroom Secrets**
[https://classroomsecrets.co.uk/campaign/science-concept-cartoons](https://classroomsecrets.co.uk/campaign/science-concept-cartoons)
Templates and resources to encourage scientific and critical thinking in the classroom.

---

## 📚 Academic Resources and Repositories

**Learner.org**
[https://www.learner.org/](https://www.learner.org/)
Educational multimedia resources and activities for science, mathematics, humanities—ideal for teachers and students.

---

**DDD UAB**
[https://ddd.uab.cat/](https://ddd.uab.cat/)
Digital repository of the Autonomous University of Barcelona to consult and download scientific-academic production.

---

**BibGuru**
[https://www.bibguru.com/es/](https://www.bibguru.com/es/)
Free bibliographic citation generator, compatible with APA, MLA and more, ideal for academic works.

---

**UPF Master Wiki – PedroGeoGISCoding**
[https://pedrogeogiscoding.github.io/wiki_MasterUPF/](https://pedrogeogiscoding.github.io/wiki_MasterUPF/)
Wiki with notes and resources on teaching geography, technology and GIS in the UPF master's degree.

## 📋 Curriculum and Educational Regulations (Spain and Catalonia)

**LOMLOE curricula by CCAA**
[https://educagob.educacionfpydeportes.gob.es/curriculo/curriculo-lomloe/curriculos-ccaa.html](https://educagob.educacionfpydeportes.gob.es/curriculo/curriculo-lomloe/curriculos-ccaa.html)

---

**XTEC Basic Curriculum**
[https://sites.google.com/xtec.cat/curriculumbasica/p%C3%A0gina-principal?authuser=0](https://sites.google.com/xtec.cat/curriculumbasica/p%C3%A0gina-principal?authuser=0)
Documentation and resources of the basic educational curriculum in Catalonia.

---

**INTEF**
[https://intef.es/](https://intef.es/)
Institute dedicated to the training and updating of teachers in educational technology and teaching resources in Spain.

---

**INEE**

Spanish National Institute that carries out evaluations and studies on the educational system and academic performance.

---

**ARC CESIRE XTEC**
[https://serveiseducatius.xtec.cat/cesire/arc/](https://serveiseducatius.xtec.cat/cesire/arc/)
Portal of resources and innovative educational proposals of the CESIRE.

---

**ARC applications XTEC**
[https://apliense.xtec.cat/arc/](https://apliense.xtec.cat/arc/)
Portal of resources and active applications for learning, linked to CESIRE-XTEC.
